name: Allergies
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign provision and care in all aspects of life, including health and healing. From the creation of plants and animals for our sustenance (Genesis 1:11; 9:3) to His promise to bless and remove sickness among His people (Exodus 23:25), God demonstrates His desire for our well-being. The Psalms affirm that the Lord forgives sins and heals diseases (Psalms 103:3), sending His word to bring deliverance and restoration (Psalms 107:20). In facing physical challenges such as allergies, believers can trust in the Lord as their strength and salvation (Psalms 27:1), confident in His power to heal and sustain them.
